Create a generic Cloud Build CI/CD pipeline template for building container images and deploying them to Cloud Run.\n4. **Migration Planning (Strategist):** Group the 100 microservices into 10 migration waves (10 services per wave) based on dependencies and business criticality. Create a detailed migration schedule and a rollback plan for one of the waves.\n5. **Validation & Documentation (Synthesizer):** Define a post-migration validation checklist (e.g., health checks, performance tests, integration tests). Consolidate all artifacts (analysis reports, architecture diagrams, IaC code, migration plan) into a single, structured mission report located in the mission artifacts directory.",
    "agents": [
      "developer",
      "architect",
      "devops",
      "strategist",
      "synthesizer"

    "swarm_type": "execution"
